documentation.description: Outputs a migration query to hash all the vendor API keys in the triplestore. Digs into GRAPH_URI (default http://mu.semte.ch/graphs/automatic-submission). SPARQL_ENDPOINT defaults to http://virtuoso:8890/sparql. Override via KEY=value arguments, e.g. mu script vendor-login hash-vendor-api-keys GRAPH_URI=http://mu.semte.ch/graphs/vendors/
